title: Eleven Years Over One Wall
subtitle: 冲突与矛盾 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 冲突与矛盾（社会服务与人际沟通·冲突与和解）
meta: 主题语境：冲突与矛盾（社会服务与人际沟通·冲突与和解）　|　核心词汇：conflict　|　正文 331 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 conflict 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1959 my two uncles ① began a conflict about a wall that belonged to neither of them, and my grandmother said the beginning was the whole of the matter. The ② conflict, meaning the quarrel and not the wall, ran eleven years and stayed that size; conflict, she said, is the only thing in a family that is judged by how little it is about.

Every ③ conflict in that street had the same witness, and the ④ conflict at the end, meaning the one they kept for the harvest and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever described twice. Conflict, my mother said, is nine parts witness and one part somebody willing to forget; my grandmother said the forgetting is the part that ends the year.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the conflict was the whole of the timetable, meaning the clash and not the quarrel. The ⑥ conflict, meaning the clash and not any of that, is the only thing in a timetable that everybody discovers and nobody planned; conflict, he said, is either something you begin or the only word that means both a quarrel and a clash. She said the clash is the part they remember.

By 1970 the ⑦ conflict had become a line in a letter, and the letter had become an argument about the witness. The ⑧ conflict of the whole thing, my grandmother wrote in October, was one wall and thirty years of forgetting; conflict, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to forget. He said the forgetting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ conflict I remember is the one at the end, which they settled in 1976 and is still described as the smallest in the county. A ⑩ conflict, my mother said in 1978, is the only thing that improves by being forgotten; every conflict, she said, is a clash that has agreed to look like a quarrel. She said the clash was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 争执（指那场争执本身，与那堵墙相对）
C. 固定搭配：begin a conflict 引发一场争执
D. n. 争执（指那条街上每一次）
E. n. 争执（指末尾那一次）
F. n. 冲突；相撞（指时间上的撞车）
G. n. 争执（指信里提到的那一场）
H. n. 矛盾；对立（抽象总称）

items.q: began a conflict about a wall that belonged to neither
The conflict, meaning the quarrel and not the wall
the conflict was the whole of the timetable
the conflict had become a line in a letter
The conflict of the whole thing
A conflict, my mother said in 1978

answers.why: begin a conflict 意为“引发一场争执”，1959 年我的两位叔叔为一堵不属于他们任何一方的墙起了争执。
conflict 意为“争执”，指那场争执本身而不是那堵墙，它持续了十一年。
conflict 指那条街上每一次争执，每一次都有同一个见证人。
conflict 指末尾那一次（他们留到丰收节的那一次），是唯一有人描述过两次的。
conflict 意为“冲突、相撞”，父亲说撞车就是那张时间表的全部，指的是时间冲突而不是那场争执。
conflict 为另一个义项，指时间上的撞车而不是那场争执，是时间表里人人都撞上、却无人安排的东西。
conflict 意为“争执”，指信里提到的那一场，到 1970 年这场争执成了信里的一行。
conflict 意为“矛盾、对立”，祖母十月写道，整件事的矛盾是一堵墙三十年的遗忘。
conflict 意为“冲突、争执”，我记得的是末尾那一场，他们 1976 年和解，至今仍被说成全县最小的。
conflict 为抽象总称，母亲说一场争执是唯一会因为被遗忘而变好的东西。

那条街上每一次争执都有同一个见证人。（conflict）

父亲说撞车就是那张时间表的全部，指的是时间冲突而不是那场争执。（conflict）

The conflict at the end, meaning the one they kept for the harvest and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever described twice.
